projects.title: Bharat Quest AI
projects.description: Offline-first classroom learning platform for smartboards built at Pranasya Technologies. Students explore a 3D map of India answering NCERT-grounded geography, history, and civics questions generated by a Python RAG pipeline, guided by a lion mascot with XP tracking and weekly leaderboards.
keyHighlights: Built a six-stage Python RAG pipeline turning NCERT Class 5-8 textbooks into a validated question bank using pypdf, all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings, and ChromaDB with 80% grounding threshold and 0.85 cosine-similarity deduplication
Shipped an offline-first React app with IndexedDB persistence and backend reconciliation on reconnect, JWT auth, and an interactive 3D India map in react-three-fiber and GSAP
Mapped all generated questions to a 30-state gazetteer with seeded, answer-position-balanced export ensuring every question is grounded in the textbook

projects.title: Quantro
projects.description: AI-driven portfolio management platform for Indian investors with portfolio tracking, trade simulation, backtesting, watchlists, and personalized stock recommendations across 50+ NSE stocks.
keyHighlights: Developed an AI-driven portfolio management platform with portfolio tracking, trade simulation, backtesting, watchlists, and personalized stock recommendations across 50+ NSE stocks
Engineered a backend market-data pipeline using GitHub Actions, AWS Lambda, and Amazon S3 to fetch, store, and process end-of-day OHLCV data for automated portfolio and analytics updates
Integrated the Claude API to generate personalized stock recommendations based on user risk profile and portfolio context, with secure JWT-based authentication

projects.title: Sniply
projects.description: Full-stack URL shortener with custom aliases, authenticated user dashboards, asynchronous click tracking, and granular analytics for browsers, operating systems, devices, and referrers.
keyHighlights: Non-blocking 307 redirect path with asynchronous write-behind logging of browser, OS, device, and referrer
Cut redirect latency ~20% via query optimisation and indexing on MongoDB
Implemented Clerk authentication for secure user dashboards and custom link management

projects.title: WhatsApp Alert & Broadcast Platform
projects.description: Robust internal notification system to orchestrate, approve, queue, and deliver WhatsApp broadcast campaigns with a secure 4-tier RBAC model, transactional message claim locks, background worker processes, and structured logging.
keyHighlights: Built a role-aware broadcast platform with four-tier RBAC (super-admin to viewer) with per-role PII phone masking and a draft to approval to queue campaign workflow

Engineered the delivery engine as a background worker using transactional claim locks (claim token + worker ID + TTL) preventing double-sends, with 30s/2m/10m exponential backoff and graceful SIGINT/SIGTERM drain
Hardened the API with HttpOnly-cookie JWT auth, CSRF tokens, rate limiting, Zod validation, SHA-256 request-hashed idempotency keys, and audit logging with GitHub Actions CI

projects.title: UrbanTwins
projects.description: Smart-city digital twin dashboard simulating traffic, energy, water, and disaster systems with interactive mapping, graph-based routing, and AI recommendations.
keyHighlights: Rendered real-time GIS mapping layers using Leaflet for urban traffic and utility monitoring
Implemented graph search algorithms for emergency vehicle routing and resource allocation
Leveraged Gemini API to deliver predictive anomaly alerts for municipal grid management
